tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal byed bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba ston pa shākya'i tog/de la dad pas rab btud nas/ /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa yon tan gyi/ /'byung gnas rmad byung 'dir 'jug bya/ /de la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang byed tshul lag len ni 'di yin te/ thog ma thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi mngon rtogs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga shes par bya ste/ dus bzang po la slob dpon bzang pos slob ma bzang po la sbyin te de yang stegs bu gru bzhi pa ras bzang pos g.yogs pa'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal gur gum gyis byugs par/ rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum gyi tshom bu dbus ma che ba/ g.yas g.yon du chung ba re re mtshar du bsgrigs/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog/shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me togalho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du lha bshos/ ji ltar bde bar gtor ma bshams/ rjes gnang du ma zhig rjes la sbrel nas byed na/ ji tsam byed pa'i lha bshos kyi grangs dang*/ gtor gsos kyi mtheb kyu/ me tog gso chas/ spos 'bul rgyu/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ dri chab gso ba dang*/ gtor ma sbyangs chas kyi chu rnams sta gon bya/ slob dpon gyi mdun du lcog rtse'i steng du ting shag dang rdor dril gang 'os/ slob ma rnams la 'thor rgyu'i me tog ting phor dang*/ slob ma rnams la 'gyed rgyu'i me tog ka to ra re las kyi rdo rje'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ de la byugs pa'i chu dang bcas pa bshams/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= lan bdun mdzad/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su dmachi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/

/'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cigarang skad cig gis thub pa rdo rje gdan du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge hūṃ gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od 'phros mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa chen po gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃbadz+ra nai we te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ / 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri phyogs bzhir bdud bzhi/ mtshams bzhir seng ge bzhis bteg pa'i steng du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ las rdo rje ser po hūṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid thub pa rdo rje gdan sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon/

g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ dbu gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ de'i g.yas su byams pa ser po g.yas rin po che'i rnga yab/ g.yon klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon na spyan ras gzigs dkar po g.yas rin po che'i rnga yab/ g.yon pad+ma bsnams pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal ras la blta ba'o/ /de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha āḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de dag gi phyag rgya spyi 'gro ltar mdzad/ yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas/ bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa/ byams pa la rnam snang/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūṃ swāhā/ zhes bzlas la/ mthar sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'khor gnyis rang la thim mo/ / oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/

'phags pa kun du bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu dpag tu med par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ aḥhūṃ/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri zhes pa nas mdun bskyed yin pas bdag nyid mi zer/ khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur zhes 'don pa spo/ gzhan dbu brgyan pa'i bar gong gi bdag bskyed dang 'dra bar mdzad nas/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wa ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar dang*/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya bh+yaḥswāhā/ mchod yon sogs kyi phyag rgya bcing*/ sarba bid la gang ba'i phyag rgya mdzad/ thabs mkhas thugs rje che sogs dang*/ byams chen me sogs dang*/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bdun tsam gyis mnyes par byas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod g.yog pa gcig gis/ thams cad la khrus kyi phyir chab btang*/ nang gi mchod g.yog pas me tog 'gyed sdud skabs cha gnyis byas la/ me tog phyed phyed slob ma so so rang gis tshags byed du 'jugagasol btab kyi dus su thal mo stong par ma song ba byed/ phyed bsdus la maṇ+ḍal phul/ gral dang me tog bkram bsdu zin pa dang*/ 'di skad ces/ 'o na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan dgongs pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan pa zhu/

'dir rgyud sde bzhi las sgrub thabs du ma gsungs pa rnams la/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon so sos sgrub thabs mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhugs pa yin la/ bsdus pa 'di bha ga la'i paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu sbas pas bsdus pa ste/ ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba 'di la sgrub thabs gzungs dang bcas pa dpe sna dgu bcu go drug yod/ sa skya ba gong ma rnams las brgyud cing thugs rtsis su mdzad pa yin la/ rgya gzhung rnams la sa bcad dang dka' gnas la dpyod pa'i mchan bu dang ṭī ka rnams yod pas 'di ni gzhung yang legs par bshad nus shing*/ shin du yid ches pa'i gnas yin pas/ de'i lugs kyi rjes gnang gi cho ga sgrub par bgyid pa la/ dang po thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ mdun du dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa la mchod bstod bzlas pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ gtor ma rnams sngon du song zin pa nas/ rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod ces bya/ slob mas 'dir maṇ+ḍal phul/ yang bla mas 'di skad ces maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shigadus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ / lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du rgyun bshags dang skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bzung ba la sogs pa bgyid snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs gsum dang*/ khyad par du thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang stsal du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shigaslob dpon dgongs su gsol/

bdag la bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab nas/ da sbyor ba rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad pa zhu/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ rin po che'i khri sogs dang*/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das thub pa zhes sogs nas/ blta ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gtso 'khor gsum bdag bskyed bzhin gsal btab bo/ /de nas slob dpon yang rang gis bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i thub pa rdo rje gdan dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thub pa rdo rje gdan 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de dag ni rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'o/ /rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum las/ dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung blang ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ ser po/ de las sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi kha nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ ser po gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags 'phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/

snying ga'i hūṃ la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūṃ swāhā gsum/ dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor phul bar mos pa mdzod cig slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig/gsum pa dam bca' ba'i lung gi phyir/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan 'di nyid ji srid byang chub ma thob bar gyi yi dam du bzung ngo*/ /bdag thugs kyis ma btang zhig snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shigaslob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas gzung nas/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ 'di'i gsang sngags nyi ma re re bzhin 'di tsam re 'don par dam bca' lags so/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ de'i dngos gzhi lung gsum song*/ da ni rjes byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung dung ba dang*/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa mdzad pas/ mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas/ thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi sku sor tshad tsam zhig rgyangs te byon/

khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di yig rnying na med na'ang phyag len la mdzad/ de nas 'di'i rgya gzhung sgrub thabs kyi lung yang spro na bya'o/ / de dag ni thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa'o/ / 'di gcig pu yin na/ gtso bos ji ltar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ gzhan dang sprel nas byed na/ slob ma rnams kyis/ slob dpon cho ga sgrub pa'i bar la mdo 'don pa sogs byed do/ /slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra muḥ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ chos thun re la rjes gnang mang po sbrel nas mdzad na/ spyir slob dpon gyi bya ba la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kun la 'dra/ tshogs zhing dang*/ tshad med rting ma rnams la mi mdzad par/ stong nyid las dam tshig pa bskyed pa sogs 'gre/ gnas gsum byin rlabs 'dra/ ye shes pa lha de dang de'i rnam par spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur 'dra/ rigs bdag so sor yod de 'gre/ bzlas pa so so/ 'dod don gsol btab 'dra/ 'khor yod na gtso bo la bsdud pa'ang 'dra/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs 'dra/ stong pa'i ngang las dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dam tshig pa bskyed pa las bdag nyid tsam pa 'jog /

gzhan so so'i bskyed chog bzhin bskyed rjes so so'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren te/ gzhan 'gre/ bzlas lung so sor 'byung*/ dam bca' lung la 'don pa spo/ byin gyis brlabs pa la so so'i lha byon pa'i dmigs pa spo/ snga ma tsho la lung gsung tshar rjes/ de dag gis ni lha 'di zhes bya ba'i rjes gnang gi cho ga'o/ / zhes brjod/ mdun bskyed kyi yi dam gshegs bsdu yang 'dra/ rjes lung tshar tshar bzhugs su bcug ste/ mchod pa 'bul/ nyin gcig gi rjes gnang rting ma la/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyis dam tshig bzung*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs tshar gsum bya/ 'dir sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang las/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang zhes sam/ rdo rje gdan la sogs pa lha khyad par du 'phags pa 'ga' zhig gi rjes gnang gsan pa yin pas/ des rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ ces byas nas bla mas rjes gnang rting ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la mchod pa gong mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i skabs kyis 'gre zhing*/ 'di skabs rnga brdung*/ bstod pa mnyam nyid mi g.yo ba byed/ dgos 'dod kyi dngos grub blang*/ yig brgya brjod/ bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ bkra shis brjod pa'i tshig ston mchog dam pa sogs te rol mo rgya cher mdzad do/ /de ltar sgrub thabs thog ma thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang spyi chings dang bcas pa bshad zin pa ltar/ legs par nges nas 'og ma 'di rnams la 'jug par bya'o/ /sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung don gcig pa rnams ni sgrub thabs dpe tshan du ma yod kyang rjes gnang gcig gis chog cing*/ cho ga'i yan lag la rgyas bsdus dang mi 'dra ba yod du zin kyang rgyu sa bon gcig cing*/ 'bras bu lha'i rnam pa rgyas 'debs rigs bdag kyang gcig cing*/ bzlas bya'i sngags kyang gcig na/

sgrub thabs don gcig par 'jog pas rjes gnang gi skabs 'dir gcig tu bsdus pas chog go /yang sgrub thabs kyi gzhung gcig gi nang nas/ lha ngo bo gcig la zhal phyag mang nyung dang*/ phyag mtshan 'dam kha yod pa sogs la don la rjes gnang gcig gis chog mod kyang*/ so sor mdzad pa'i phyag len yod pa/ 'grub na rjes gnang rkang tshugs re re bya/ bsdu na 'dam kha'i lha gnyis kar dus gcig tu bskyed nas/ bzlas lung sogs gcig gis chog pa byas kyang rung*/ yang na 'dam kha yod pa rnams la rgyas bsdus yod na rgyas pa'i phyogs de la rjes gnang bya/ rgyas bsdus kyi khyad med na gang yang rung ba zhig gi rjes gnang byas pa/ gzhan de rnams la yang na bcom ldan 'das 'di zhal phyag rnam pa 'di dag 'di lta bur bsgom par rung ba yin no/ / zhes brjod na'ang legs so/ /gzhang yang spyir btang gi dbang du byas nas/ zhi ba rnams la lha rdzas kyi dar sna tshogs pas smad dkris dang stod g.yogs gsol ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan/ do shal dpung rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ mtshar sdug phun sum tshogs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar zhing 'phro ba zhes pa dang*/ de'i nang tshan lha pho la/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs sam/ rin po che'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa zhes lhag por brjod/ lha mo la sked skabs phra zhing*/ nu 'bur rgyas pa/ dbu skra ltag par bcings pa/ 'dzum zhing yid du 'ong pa'i rnam pa zhes lhag por brjod/ khro bo rnams la sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa ljags 'gril ba dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig bgrad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra ser po'am dmar po'am/ dmar ser ram/ kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can gdug pa'i sbrul chen po brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa

zhes dang*/ khro mo la yang de dang 'dra ba las/ sma ra ser po zhes pa spangs la/ nu 'bur lhag par rgyas pa zhes lhag por brjod/ 'di rnams 'og gi sgrub thabs so so'i skabs thams cad du ma rjed cing dran pa gal che'o/ /dmigs gsal yod pa rnams so so'i skabs su shes par bya'o/ /da ni so so'i sgrub thabs brjod par bya ste/ 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs gsum la rjes gnang gcig bya ste/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ āḥlas zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge muḥ dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal bstan pa'i 'khor lo/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon po ti thugs kar bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ ral ba'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa'o/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi skabs dang 'dra/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na muḥ bstod pa la/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron mes rab brgyan zhing*/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa ste/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs thams cad la yang bstod pa 'di kho na sbyar ro/ /'di la rgya gzhung gsum yod pa'i nang nas/ slob dpon bha ba skan dhas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma'i dkyus su sku mdog mchod brjod las/ 'od zer dkar po gyen du 'phro zhing 'bar ba yi/ zhes 'byung ba la bsams nas/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo dkar po yin par 'dod pa ni/ sa bon gyi skabs su steng du sgron me'i 'od gsal gur gum dmar po ste/ de la yang ni sngags pas muḥyig blta bar bya/ zhes sogs rgyu'i sa bon dang*/

sngags 'khor gyi sa bon dang*/ sngags 'khor nyid kyang dmar por bshad pa ma go zhing sgrub thabs tshig lhug pa las gur gum mdog tu gsal bar bshad pa dang*/ tshig lhug pa'i sgrub thabs 'di tshigs bcad pa'i gsal byed kyi man ngag yin pa ma shes par zad do/ /sgrub thabs gsum pa brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa lo chen 'gyur las kyang*/ ban dhu ka'i me tog ltar dmar ba chen po zhes 'byung la/ sgrub thabs gsum dgongs pa gcig tu snang ba'i phyir/ dmar po nyid yin la/ gur gum lta bu zhes dmar ser gcig tu mi 'gal mod/ kha che'i yul pal pur gyi ri la rang skyes pa'i gur gum me tog rgyas pa'i skabs shin tu dmar shas che ba la bsam par snang la/ 'di'i sku 'dra rgya gar gyi bris sku dngos la mtshal mdog tu snang ngo*/ /'di'i cho ga'i yan lag rnams skabs 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre bar bya ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rnams so so'i skabs su brjod par bya'o// // ༄༅/ /a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gnyis la rjes gnang gcig ste/ pad zla'i steng du dhīḥlas rang nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas ral gri dpung pa'i thad kar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i po ti thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ na bza' dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs bsnabs pa/ snying gar a las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ lte ba dang phyogs kyi rtsibs rnams la zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su āḥlas rang dang 'dra ba'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ shar du ra las dra ba can gyi 'od ma/ rgyab tu pa las zla 'od ma/ g.yas su tsa las skra can ma/ g.yon du na las nye ba'i skra can ma rnams lha mo'i mtshan nyid rdzogs shing*/ sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul rgyan gos rnams gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ lha lnga po'i thugs kar yang rang rang gi sa bon dang*/

mtshams kyi rtsibs bzhi la shar lho nas g.yas skor gyis/ ni pra pa tsa zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi'o/ / dbu brgyan ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ 'di la sgrub thabs gnyis yod pa las/ tshigs bcad ma mi pham bshes gnyen gyi mdzad la/ tshig lhug pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'o// // ༄༅/ /rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las byung ba'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i steng du sa bon yi ge muḥlas/ rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal gur gum bzang po lta bu/ g.yas zhal sngo zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na ral gri/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum na sher phyin gyi po ti dang*/ ut+pal la sngon po dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon rgyab rnams su 'chang ba'i dbu skra lcang lo gsum dang ldan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs shing*/ me tog gi rgyan dang ldan pa/ rigs bdag ni rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /sngags ni oṃ muḥ zhes pa'o// // ༄༅/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la rma bya nyams rtsal rgyas pa re re/ de rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus su maṃ las rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ shar du gti mug gzhon nu ma/ lhor 'dod chags gzhon nu ma/ nub tu phrag dog gzhon nu ma/ byang du rigs kyi gzhon nu ma rnams/ g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon ral gri 'dzin pas thugs kar bsnol ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med/ sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥmaṃ ho maṃ hūṃ// //༄༅/ /'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i gdan la muṃḥlas rang nyid 'jam dpal gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/

g.yon pas ut+pa la sngon po snyan gyi thad na kha bye ba'i steng na po ti dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud gsum dang ldan pa/ seng ge sngon po ral pa dmar ser gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i steng du/ pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ zhes mna' chan las bshad kyang*/ de ltar na gshin rje gshed kyi phyag reg stabs mi bde bas g.yon brkyang nyid gzhung gi dgongs par mngon no/ / g.yon gyi 'og zur du gshin rje mthar byed nag po/ phyag g.yas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhabs kyi ngar gdong g.yon pa la reg cing*/ phyag g.yon dbyug pa om tshugs su mdzad pa/ thod skam gyi phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ dharma dhā tu wā gī shwa ri muṃ// //༄༅/ /'jam dpal rgyal po rol pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i steng du/ maṃ las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas kyi phyag mthil pus mo g.yas la bkab pa'i tshul gyis 'gying bag dang bcas pa/ g.yon pa gdan la brten pas ut+pa la'i sdong po snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba 'dzin pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs las/ g.yas rol gyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ wa gī shwa ri muṃḥ //༄༅/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las 'byung ba 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs gnyis la rjes gnang gcig ni/ pad zla'i steng du dhīḥyig zhu ba las thig le dkar po/ de las rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon ut+pal la gnas pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang*/ sngags ni/ oṃ dhīḥswāhā/ rgya gzhung gi glegs bam las bar skabs 'dir 'bar 'dzag gi sgo nas shes rab bskyed pa'i gzhung cig yod de/

rjes gnang mi dgos so// // ༄༅/ /mtshan brjod las 'byung ba'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sgrub thabs ni/ hrīḥlas pad+ma/ a las zla ba la sa bon muḥ dmar skya las/ rang nyid 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar skya/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs shing*/ g.yas sngon g.yon dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang po ti/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ snying gar sems ma rdo rje ma/ dpral bar rin chen rdo rje ma/ mgrin par pad+ma rdo rje ma/ spyi bor las kyi rdo rje ma/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa/ sngags ni mtshan brjod kyi sngags 'og ma yongs rdzogs sam bsdu na/ oṃ hūṃ hrīḥbha ga wān dz+nyā na murti wa gī shwa ra mahā wā tsa/ sarba dharmā/ ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shud+dha/ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha a// //༄༅/ /mtshan brjod las 'byung ba chos dbyings gsung dbang gi sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la a yig las dpal chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi char yang dkar ba/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ lhag ma g.yas gsum gyis ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ g.yon gsum gyis/ po ti gzhu/ dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ snying gar hūṃ/ dpral bar trāṃ/ mgrin par hrīḥ spyi bor a rnams las byung ba'i/ rdo rje rin po che/ pad+ma rgya gram rnams phyag rgya bzhi'i bdag nyid do/ / rigs bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa duḥkha tshe da pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mur ta ye/ dz+nyā na kā ya wa gī shwa ra a ra pa tsa na ya te na maḥ༄༅/ /rdo rje gur las gsungs pa 'jam dpal yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la haṃ las mda' gzhu haṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid yan lag med pa'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis ut+pal dmar po'i mde'u can gyis mda' dang*/

me tog dmar po'i gzhu rna ba'i bar du 'gengs par mdzad pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang me long*/ g.yon gnyis kyis ut+pal sngon po'i sdong po dang mya ngan med dmar po'i shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ ral ba'i cod pan can/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i na tshod do/ / sngags ni/ oṃ mañju gho ga hrīḥdzaḥ zhes pa'o/ /yang na 'di phyag bzhi pa bsgom ste/ me long dang/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa'i phyag spangs pa'o// // ༄༅/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo chig grub kyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba la/ maṃ las rang nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dkar po zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ wā kye dā na na maḥ //༄༅/ /'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i steng du a las ral gri as mtshan pa las/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs dang 'dra ba las/

zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung dang na bza' dar sna tshogs/ rigs bdag ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa dhāṃ/ zhes pa ste/ rjes gnang skabs mngon rtogs de tsam gyis chog la/ 'di nyid nyams su len na sngags 'khor bsgom pa gal che'o/ /de yang lte 'og tu bh+rūṃ las zla ba byang chub shing gi lo ma lta bu de'i steng du hri las pad sdong pad+ma kha zum pa'i lte bar hūṃ ste de'i 'od kyis yid tsam kha bye ba/ de'i steng du a las zla ba/ de la sor gcig tsam ma reg par 'khor lo rtsibs drugalte bar dhīḥrtsibs la ma ning spangs pa'i dbyangs bcu gnyis kyi yi ge gnyis gnyis/ de dag gi steng du yi ge drug gi yi ge re re yod pa/ mu khyud la sna ldan spangs pa'i ā li kā li/ 'khor lo 'di mi 'khor lo / de nas sor do tsam dhīḥl ma reg par/ zla ba la 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa la a ra pa tsa na'o/ / 'di drag tu 'khor ba'o/ / ༄༅/ /'phral du nyams su myong bar byed pa'i a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du lha bskyed pa'i rgyu aḥlas byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥlas byung ba'i ral gri'o/ /ral gri'i rtse mor a las zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥ'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na sgrub thabs gong bzhin bskyed/ thugs kar lha lnga'i gtso bo yang*/ a las zla ba dhīḥlas ral gri/ de'i rtse mor a las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa'i dhā+-iḥ'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las bskyed/ 'khor bzhi po yang des rigs 'gre ste/ a las zla ba la ra las ral gri/ rtse mor a las zla ba la gnas pa'i ras mtshon pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ dra ba can gyi 'od du bskyed pa sogs so/ /rigs bdag ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /sngags ni/ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ cho ga lhag ma rnams a ra pa tsa na gong ma dang 'dra'o/ /de yan chad kyis 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs rnams bstan zin to/

/'og nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje chos 'jam dpal gyi rigs su bsdu ba'i 'dod pa ltar na/ 'jam dpal zhi ba'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs su blangs na legs so// //༄༅/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs gsum yod la/ de'i nang nas phyag mang gi sgrub thabs gnyis las 'byung ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gnad gcig kyang rnam grangs kyi dbang du byas na nang sel gyi dbye bas sgrub thabs gsum mam bzhir yang 'gyur mod/ 'dir gshin rje gshed phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs dang po rkang tshugs dang*/ phyi ma'i 'dam kha zhig gi lugs ni 'di yin te/ paṃ las pad+ma/ de'i steng du aṃ las zla ba dang raṃ las nyi ma 'dam kha yin/ de'i steng du hūṃ las khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed po/ sku mdog nag po zhal drugaphyag drug zhabs drug pa zhal drug kar yang gnag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri/ tho ba/ rdo rje/ g.yon pas gsum gyis gtun shing*/ zhags pa dril bu bsnams pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis 'khyud rgya mdzad pa zhabs rnams g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang la sogs pa'i stabs sna tshogs pas/ pad nyi dang ma he'i steng du gshin rje brdzis pa/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal can sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥbi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /spros med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ / ces pa ste/ gzhan gnyis la'ang bstod pa 'dis 'gre'o/ /'di ni gshin rje gshed gdong drug gi rgyud du grags pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo'i las grub pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud ces kyang bya/ sdom gsum pa zhes kyang grags pa las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sgrub thabs kho na'o/

/'di la 'dam kha'i tshul du zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis pa/ zhal gsum kar nag pa/ g.yas gsum 'khor lo/ ral gri/ gtun shing*/ g.yon gsum ro langs mo dang*/ dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni man ngag las 'byung ba'am/ gdong drug gi rgyud rgyas pa las 'byung ba'o// // ༄༅/ /gshin rje gshed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma aṃ las nyi ma hūṃ las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po 'phyar ba/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas pad+ma nyi ma ma he khros pa'i gdan la gnas pa/ lhag ma rgyan cha lugs rigs bdag sngags rnams gong bzhin no/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i gshin rje gshed dmar po yang skabs 'dir blangs nas rjes gnang byas na legs so// // ༄༅/ /rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dang aṃ las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥlas rang nyid rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis rdo rje seng ge'i khri dang pad zla la bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar pad zla la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ hūṃ yig de sangs rgyas lnga'i ngo bo'o/ /lce rdo rje dmar skya rtse mo'i cha la hrīḥs mtshan pa/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ sgrub thabs 'di blo bzang snying po'i man ngag 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa'o// // ༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du siṃ las seng ge dkar po/ ral pa dmar po can/ gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i rgyab tu zla gdan la hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po/

ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi rtse mor rin po che'i tog can/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum pa/ rgyan spangs pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs shing*/ phyag g.yas pa zhabs kyi pus mo'i steng du bkab pa/ g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ sku'i g.yas ngos su mdung rtse gsum la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa/ g.yon ngos su thod pa dri zhim me tog sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang*/ pad+ma'i sdong po me tog snyan gyis thad kar kha bye ba la/ ral gri 'bar bas mtshan pa dang bcas pa/ sku las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga spro bar mdzad pa'o/ / sgrub thabs 'dir ma bshad kyang tshangs pa'i skud pa dang bcas pa/ dar dmar po'am stag lpags kyi smad dkris can du bya zhing*/ ri dwags kriṣ+ṇa'i pags pas se ral khar byas pa/ yang lugs 'ga' zhig la yod pa ltar 'dir yang mi 'gal lo/ /rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ā hrīḥsing ha nā da hūṃ phaṭa/ bstod pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun gyi gzhi/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal bstod/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs 'og ma rnams la'ang bstod pa 'di kho nas chog go/ // ༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs hā la hā la'i sgrub thabs dkyus ma ni/ pad zla'i steng du hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags pa hā la hā la sku mdog dkar po/ rtsa zhal dkar g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba'i zhal gsum/ zhal re re bzhin spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis mchog sbyin/ 'phreng ba/ mda'/ g.yon pa gsum gyis lha mo'i nu ma/ pad+ma dkar po gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon phyogs nas lha mo 'dod ldan mas 'khyud pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang ral pa'i cod pan la zla ba byed pas mdzes pa yid tsam khro ba/ g.yas su rtse gsum la sbrul gyis dkris pa dang*/ g.yon du thod pa me tog sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang bcas shing*/

rin po che mi g.yo ba'i brag phug na bzhugs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med/ sngags ni/ oṃ hā la hā la hrīḥ/ //༄༅/ /'phags pa kha sar+pa ṇa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rnyog pa med pa'i lugs ni/ hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs can/ g.yas su sgrol ma ljang khu mchog sbyin dang ut+pal can bzhengs pa/ nor bzang ser po pus btsugs thal mo sbyar ba/ mchan khung du po ti can/ gtso bo'i g.yon du khro gnyer can/ dkar la ser ba'i mdangs can bzhengs pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis thal mo dang dbyug gu/ g.yon gnyis phreng ba dang spyi blugs/ rta mgrin dmar po khrau bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ dbu'i steng du rta mgo ljang khu can/ phyag g.yas gtso bo'i pus mo la reg cing*/ g.yon dbyug pa om tshugs can/ rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ / gzhung las mi gsal yang*/ gtso bo'i sku gzhogs su nor bzang dang rta mgrin gnyis dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon du gzhan gnyis bzhugs pa yin par gsal lo/ /rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med/ sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā// //༄༅/ /'phags pa ye ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pa'i lugs ni/ pad zla'i steng du hrīḥlas/ dbus su rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs g.yas g.yon du skad cig gis grub pa'i tshul gyis/ sras nor bu 'dzin pa dang*/ yum yi ge drug ma ste gsum kar yang sku mdog dkar po/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas 'phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ so sor pad zla'i gdan re re la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ// //༄༅/ /ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ni/

stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ paṃ las chu/ laṃ las sa ste 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ suṃ las byung ba'i ri rab rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ g.yas gsum sangs rgyas la dpang por gsol ba'i thal mo dang bgrang 'phreng dang*/ ngan 'gro'i sems can la thar pa'i lam ston pa'i phyag rgya sa gnon lta bu mdzad pa/ g.yon gsum na dbyug to dang*/ ri dwags kriṣ+ṇa'i pags pa dang*/ spyi blugs rnams 'dzin pa/ rlung me gnas gyur pa'i seng ge dkar po lha tshangs pa'i ngo bo dang*/ chu gnas gyur pa'i bya khyung kha dog lnga pa drag po'i ngo bo dang*/ sa dang ri rab gnas gyur pa'i khyab 'jug chen po dang gzugs nyid de/ lha chen po gsum gyi gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni snang ba mtha' yas so/ /sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ rjes gnang byed pa'i bdag bskyed kyi sgrub thabs 'di tsam gyis chog la/ sgrub pa nyams len la bskyed chog gi rim pa gzhan yod pa gzhung bzhin byed dgos te/ snga phyi'i sgrub thabs gzhan mang po zhig la'ang de ltar go dgos so// // ༄༅/ /'phags pa hā la hā la rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs ni/ gzhan thams cad hā la hā la snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ g.yon zhal dmar po'o/ / sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥhā la hā la 'i sgrub thabs 'di gnyis ka /slob dpon lhan skyes rol pas mdzad ces 'byung la/ lha mo ni bris sku rnying pa yid ches can las sku mdog ljang khur bris snang la gzhung phyi ma 'di las yum skyil krung gis bzhugs par bshad pa 'dra rung zhig byung kyang*/ 'gyur skyon yin par mngon pas ji ltar bde bar bya'o// // ༄༅/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla ba la hrīḥlas rang nyid 'jig rten mgon po pad+ma gar dbang sku mdog dmar po/

phyag g.yon pas sku'i g.yon phyogs su gnas pa'i yum gos dkar mo la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin zhing*/ g.yas pa khab kyi phyag rgya dang gar gyi tshul gyis thugs kar pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ shin tu chags pa'i nyams can/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du rnam gzigs ma dkar mo pad dmar 'dzin pa/ lhor sgrol ma ljang khu pad ljang 'dzin pa/ nub tu dbang phyug ma ser mo ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ byang du khro gnyer ma dkar mo pad ser 'dzin pa/ shar lhor pad+ma la gnas pa mo ser mo pad dmar 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma sngo sangs pad dkar 'dzin pa/ nub byang du sna tshogs pad+ma dkar mo pad+ma nag po 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sna tshogs rdo rje ma khra mo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sems dpa'i skyil krung phyag g.yon pa gdan la brten pa'am/ yang na gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma na ra te shwa ra hūṃ// //༄༅/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa las 'byung ba 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor ro/ /de'i nang du mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs sku mdog bung ba ltar gnag pa/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal lnga phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal mthing nag/g.yas zhal dkar po dang dmar po/ g.yon zhal ser po dang ljang khu/ g.yas rnams na ḍā ma ru dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ mda' rnams so/ /g.yon rnams na sdigs mdzub dang*/ thod pa dang*/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ nor bu dang*/

'khor lo dang*/ gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /zhal thams cad rab tu khros pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang*/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon gyi do shal dang ldan pa/ dbu rgyan ni rdo rje sems dpa'o zhes 'dod mod/ 'od dpag med kyang rung ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ i ti mu ni wa ra badz+ra hrīḥhūṃ dzaḥ sgrub thabs 'di slob dpon dze tā ris mdzad/ rgya gzhung gi dpe 'ga' re las 'di glegs bam gyi gzhug rang na 'dug cing*/ bla ma gong ma'i yig sna na'ang*/ kun gyi tha mar 'bud pa mdzad mod kyi/ sde tshan bsgrigs pa'i phyir 'dir blangs pa nyid legs shing*/ 'og gi khams gsum dbang sdud kyi sgrub thabs kyang*/ skabs 'dir blangs na sde tshan bsgrig pa'i phyir legs so/ /de 'dir blangs na de yan chad kyis spyan ras gzigs dbang gi sde tshan rnams rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /de nas 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rnams 'byung ste/ slob dpon rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa la/ pad zla la tāṃ las ut+pa la tāṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang khu/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung ngam/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag ni don yon grub pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re a mu kaṃ wa sha ma na ye swāhā/ sgrub thabs 'di slob dpon rdo rje myu gus mdzad do/ /'di'i chan bu rnying pa las/ zhabs kyi bzhugs stangs bzhengs bzhugs gang byas kyang 'dra zhes bshad la/ man ngag las dmar mor yang 'dod skad do/ bstod pa ni/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyi sogs bya ste/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs 'og ma rnams la yang des rigs 'gre'o// // ༄༅/ /sgrol dkar gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ suṃ las byung ba'i ri rab kyi steng du/ pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ las rang nyid sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ut+pa la'i phyag rgya thugs kar mching ba/ de ni srin lag mthe bos mnan/ mthe'u chung bsgrengs te gshibs/ gung mo bsgreng ba'i rgyab tu mdzub mo brten pa'o/ /g.yas 'og mas rin po che dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ g.yas su 'od zer can ma ser mo sha 'gag dmar po dang stod gos sngon po can/ g.yas rnga yab g.yon mya ngan med pa'i yal gasku'i g.yon du rma bya chen mo ljang khu/ g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon rma bya'i mjug sgro/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag tu med pa'am/ yang na rigs lnga char gyis dbu brgyan no/ /sngags ni/ oṃ na maḥtā re ma no ha re hūṃ ha re swāhā// //༄༅/ /seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i steng du tāṃ las ut+pal tāṃ gis mtshan pa las/ 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang khu/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ g.yas su 'od zer can ma ser mo rdo rje dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa/ g.yon du ral gcig ma nag mo khro mo'i cha byad can gri gug thod khrag bsnams pa'o/ / yig sna las gtso 'khor gsum ka rnam pa 'dra bar bshad na'ang*/

'dir sgrub thabs khungs ma gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bkod la/ mna' chan rigs gcig las gnyis po'i phyag g.yas na rnga yab 'dzin pa dang*/ gzhan dkyus dang 'dra ba yang byas 'dug pa ji ltar 'os par sbyar ro/ /rigs bdag ni don grub bo/ /sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā// //༄༅/ /'chi ba blu ba'i sgrol ma'am/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo ni/ pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la/ tāṃ las rang nyid sgrol ma dkar mo/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu rgyan ni ba ri'i lugs 'di la 'od dpag med yin la/ sngags ni yi ge bcu pa nyid do/ /spel tshig sbyor na/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ 'og nas 'byung ba rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyang skabs 'dir blangs te rjes gnang byas na shin tu legs la/ tha mar 'byung ba'i sgrol dkar zhal gsum phyag drug pa ni skabs 'dir blangs na legs mod kyang*/ 'jug gi rten 'brel bkra legs pa'i phyir du/ thams cad kyi tha mar mdzad pa nyid lag len yin no/ /skabs 'dir sgrol ma'i sde tshan de tsam zhig yin la/ spyir ku lu kul+le dang*/ khro gnyer can ma dang*/ ral gcig ma sogs kyang sgrol ma'i rigs su 'dod cing*/ sgrol ma'i phyogs gtogs thams cad kyang spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs kyi rjes 'brang gi sde tshan no// // ༄༅/ /da ni 'od zer can ma'i sde tshan rnams bshad pa las/ thog mar o ḍi ya na'i 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi sdong pos skor ba'i mchod rten gyi nang du/ pad zla'i gdan la oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /nyi ma'i steng du maṃ/ nyi ma maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma dmar mo cher khros pa/ khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas nag po dang ljang khu/

g.yon ser po dang dkar po/ steng zhal phag gdong nag po ste zhal drugaphyag g.yas drug na ral gri/ rdo rje gtun shing*/ mda'/ mtshon rtse gcig pa/ dgra sta'o/ /g.yon drug na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ thod khragamya ngan med pa'i yal gatshangs pa'i mgo bo/ gzhu/ rtse gsum rnams 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis/ pad zla'i steng du bgegs tshogs mnan pa'i phag gi steng na gnas pa/ de'i mdun du pho nya mo dmar mo sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang*/ shing a sho ka'i yal ga bsnams pa/ phag gis drangs pa'i shing rta la zhon pa'o/ / 'di gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar na de ltar yin la/ mna' chan las ni gtso mo nyid phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i dbus su bzhugs pa dang*/ pho nya mo gtso mo'i zhabs gnyis kyi bar na gnas mar bshad do/ /rigs bdag ni rnam snang ser po'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ma ri ts+yai aṃ aṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin zhing dran pas kyang*/ sogs te 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs 'og ma rnams la'ang bstod pa de kho na'o// // ༄༅/ /rtog pa las 'byung ba 'od zer can ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi'i steng du maṃ las rang nyid 'od zer can mar gyur pa ni/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi sdong pos bskor ba'i dbus su/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo mchod rten yangs shing rgya che ba'i bum pa'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ haṃ las gza' chen po rā hu la srin po'i lus can ro smad med pa lag tu nyi zla 'dzin pa de lta bu rmig pas brdzi bar byed pa/ phag pa bdun gyis drangs pa'i rin po che'i shing rta'i steng du/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog ser mo/ zhi ma khro/ rtsa zhal ser ba/ g.yas dmar ba/ g.yon phag gdong sngon po cher khros pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na rdo rje/

lcags kyu/ mda'/ khab/ g.yon bzhi na shing a sho ka'i yal gagazhu/ skud pa/ zhags pa 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub bo/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang bas rol pas bzhugs pa'am/ bzhengs pa ji ltar 'os par bya/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dmar po sha 'gags sbu gu can dang stod g.yogs gsol ba/ shar du bad ta li dkar mo/ khab/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ a sho ka rnams 'dzin pa/ lhor bā da li ser mo mya ngan med pa/ khab dang*/ rdo rje zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ nub tu ba ra li dkar mo rdo rje/ zhags pa/ khab dang*/ mya ngan med 'dzin pa/ byang du bā rā hā mu khi dmar mo/ rdo rje/ mda' dang*/ zhags pa/ a sho ka 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phag gi gdong can g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ lhag ma gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ / oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ yang rtog pa'i 'od zer can ma ser mo de kho na 'dra ba las/ sngags oṃ ma ri ts+yai swāhā/ zhes pa ste yang na sgrub thabs 'di gnyis gcig tu sdoms kyang rung bar bzhed do// // ༄༅/ /rtog pa las 'byung ba 'od zer can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la maṃ las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma dkar mo rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas nag pa/ g.yon phag gdong dmar ba/ rgyab zhal ljang khu/ steng zhal ser po/ phyag g.yas lnga na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rdo rje sngon po/ mda'/ lcags kyu dang*/ khab rnams so/ /g.yon pa lnga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gzhu/ mya ngan med pa/ zhags pa 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub/ skud pa'o/ /dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ sha 'gag sbu gu can gsol ba/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum dang*/ gar stabs kyis khyab 'jug brgya byin tshangs pa rnams mnan pa/ gzhan ser mo phyag brgyad kyi skabs dang 'dra ba la/ gza' chen po dgu dang nad kyi bdag po thams cad mi'i gzugs can du gnas pa rnams brji zhing tha bar byed pa'i phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas shing*/ mchod rten gyi bum pa'i khongs su rgyu ba/

gtso mo'i mdun du pho nya mo nag mo chu srin la zhon pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ g.yas su pho nya dmar mo phyag bzhi/ lcags kyu/ khab dang zhags pa/ skud pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon du pho nya dmar mo phyag bzhi/ mda' gzhu bkar zhing rdo rje dang*/ mya ngan med pa 'dzin pa/ pho nya gsum kar yang phag gi gdong can g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag sngar dang 'dra/ sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā// //༄༅/ /mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ phag ser po'i steng du pad zla la/ maṃ las 'od zer can ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ rab tu zhi ba sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mya ngan med pa'i sdong po la rgyab brten zhing*/ phyag g.yon pas de'i yal ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin no/ / dbu rgyan gong bzhin/ sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ swāhā// //༄༅/ /yang o ḍi ya na'i 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa'i lugs ni/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du/ phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng pad nyi la/ maṃ las 'od zer can dmar mo cher khros pa/ rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas nag po dang dkar po/ g.yon ser po dang ljang khu/ steng phag gdong nag po/ phyag g.yas drug ral gri/ 'khor lo/ gtun shing*/ mda'/ dgra sta/ rtse gcigagayon zhags par bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gathod pa/ a sho ka tshangs mgo gzhu/ rtse gsum mo/ /mi mgo skam po brgyad brgyad kyi dbu rgyan dang*/ mgo 'phreng dang*/ sbrul dang*/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /mdun du pho nya mo dkar mo phag gdong can/ phyag bzhi rdo rje/ khab/ a sho ka sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sha 'gags ser po'i steng du/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ rigs bdag ni 'dra/ sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā//

//༄༅/ /o rgyan rim pa'i 'od zer can ma rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma'am/ ro langs 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ bsrung 'khor du gyur pa'i nang du/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dur khrod chen pos bskor ba'i dbus/ o ḍi ya na'i gnas gru gsum dkar la dmar ba'i gnas kyi gzhal med khang pa'i nang du/ nyi ma la rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer can ma dmar mo cher khros pa/ rtsal zhal dmar ba/ g.yas gnyis dkar po dang nag po/ g.yon gnyis ser po dang nag po/ steng phag zhal nag po/ phyag g.yas drug na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ ka ṇa ya/ dgra sta/ mda'/ gtun shing*/ g.yon drug khab dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ rtse gsum/ a sho ka /gzhu/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo'o/ /zhabs bzhi g.yon brkyang bas bdud bzhi mnan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang*/ yan lag nying lag thams cad la mi mgo rlon pa'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa/ khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dha tri shwa rī sarba duṣ+tan ha na ha na ha da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā// //༄༅/ /lha mo bskul byed ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la tsuṃ yig las/ lha mo tsun da dkar mo phyag bzhi/ g.yas dang po mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang po sher phyin gyi po tis mtshan pa'i pad+ma dkar po/ 'og ma gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun de swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba thams cad mnyes mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i don chen bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rigs sngags lha mo'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes pas bstod de/ 'chad pa 'gyur ba'i lha mo'i sgrub thabs sgos su bstod pa med pa kun la tshigs bcad 'di kho nas bstod par bya'o//

// ༄༅/ /'phags pa dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la dzaṃ yig las 'phags pa dzam+bha la sku mdog ser po sha nyams rgyas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gdangs pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na shing thog bi dza pū ra ka 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas dung gi tshogs dang pad+ma'i tshogs la sogs pa'i gter mnan pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i do shal can/ gzhan zhi ba spyi dang mtshungs pa rigs bdag ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len dra ye swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ nor gyi dbang phyug sogs so// // ༄༅/ /dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la hūṃ las dzam+bha la nag po mi'u thung gi gzugs rigs ngan gyi cha byad rna ba ma phug pa/ gcer bu phyag g.yas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon ne'u le nor bu skyug pa 'dzin zhing brla la brten pa/ rtags gyen du langs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas nor bdag ser po rin po che'i snye ma skyug pa mnan pa/ lhag ma khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa/ sngags ni gong bzhin nam oṃ swāhā/ bstod pa yang gong bzhin nam/ mgon po nam mkha'i rang bzhin sogs so// // ༄༅/ /nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la baṃ las lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang gter gyi bum pa lhan cig 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin mdza' bo thams cad kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /mdza' mo'i skye 'gros bskor zer ba'ang yod/ rigs bdag ni rin 'byung*/ sngags ni/ oṃ shrī ba su ni dha na k+ṣe tre swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ gang ston sbyin pa rgya mtsho

sogs so/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i dzam+bha lha mang gi sgrub thabs yang skabs 'dir blangs la rjes gnang bya'o// // ༄༅/ /'phags ma khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la yi ge bh+riṃ las/ rang nyid khro gnyer can ma ser mo zhi ba ral ba'i cod pan can/ phyag g.yas gnyis mchog sbyin dang*/ 'phreng ba/ g.yon gnyis dbyug pa dang ril pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med/ sngags ni/ oṃ bh+riṃ swāhā// //༄༅/ /sgyu drwa las gsungs pa 'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la maiṃ las rang nyid mgon po byams pa gser gyi mdog can/ zhal gsum char ser ba'am/ ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal gsum gang rigs bya/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ g.yas 'og ma mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'og mas klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ maiṃ me tṛ ye swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ byams chen me yi sogs so// // ༄༅/ /rdo rje gur las 'byung ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la/ aṃ las rang nyid sher phyin dkar mo phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar na chos 'chad kho nas g.yas na pad+ma dmar po dang*/ g.yon na po ti bsnams pa yin la/

man ngag ltar na/ phyag mthil las gyes pa'i g.yas su pad dkar dang*/ g.yon du pad dmar snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi po ti re dang bcas pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni mi skyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi war+dha ni swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ smra bsam brjod med sogs te/ sher phyin gyi sgrub thabs 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o// // ༄༅/ /gdan bzhi'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dge 'dun byin gyis bus mdzad pa'i lugs ni/ pad zla la praṃ las sher phyin dkar mo snga ma'i man ngag dang mtshungs pa bskyed de/ sngags ni/ oṃ praṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'o// // ༄༅/ /sher phyin ser mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la dhīḥlas rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ser mo phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon gyi mthil nas gyes pa'i pad ma sngon po'i sdong bu po tis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung ngo*/ / dbu rgyan ni rnam snang ngo*/ sngags ni/ oṃ pradz+nyo mahā pradz+nyo shru tri smṛ ti bi dza ya dhīḥswāhā/ yang sher phyin ser mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ba las/ pad ma'i tshab tu ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa dang*/ sngags ni/ oṃ āḥdhīḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes bzla ba ni khyad par ro/ /'og gi gser mdog can gyi sher phyin ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ phyag na pad+ma 'dzin pa yin/ gzhan de kho na dang 'dra ste/ 'di la pad+ma dang ut+pal 'dam kha yin/ gzhan khyad med pas/ sgrub thabs 'di gnyis la rjes gnang gcig gis chog par bzhed do// // ༄༅/ /mdor bsdus pa'i sher phyin sor mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ gzhan thams cad de dang 'dra ba las/ gdan pad+ma dmar po des gzungs can dang*/ sngags ni/ oṃ dhīḥshru tri smṛ ti bi dza ye swāhā/

sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i glegs bam 'dir khro rgyal mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs mdzad byang med pa zhig la dpe tshan gcig dang*/ mngon rtogs med pa'i las tshogs rkyang pa la 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa'i mdzad byang 'byar ba zhig dang*/ sgrub thabs gzhon nu sbas pas mdzad pa ste/ chos tshan gsum yod cing*/ thog ma de la dze tā ris mdzad zer ba mchan bu rnying pa na snang*/ 'on kyang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho na chos tshan snga ma'i gzhug gi dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba de med par/ thog ma dang bar pa'i dpe tshan gnyis po sbrel nas/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pas mdzad par bshad pa ltar legs par mngon no/ /'on kyang gzhung 'dir da lta 'byung ba ltar na/ chos tshan bar pa ni las tshogs kho na ston byed yin pas rjes gnang med la/ thog mtha' gnyis la rjes gnang gcig gis chog go / de yang pad nyi la hūṃ las rang nyid khro rgyal mi g.yo ba sku mdog zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo ba/ rol pa'i khro bo zhes bya ba zhi ma khro'i cha byad can/ sku lus 'khrang zhing grims pa/ spyan gnyis g.yas pa gyen dang g.yon pa thur la gzigs pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ sma ra ag tshom spangs pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan zhing*/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub snying gar gtod pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi mthil dang*/ g.yon gyi pus mo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la brtad de phyed tsam bzhengs pa/ der dmar po'i 'dom dkris dang*/ sbrul gyi do shal dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ bstod pa ni/ gang gi rang bzhin khro dang rnam bral yang*/ /zhe sdang can la khro ba'i rnam pa dang*/ /mthun par bstan pas khro sogs zhi mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub 'di brnyes mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bstod pa 'di ni khro bo'i sgrub thabs sgos kyi bstod pa med pa kun la'ang sbyar bar bya'o//

// ༄༅/ /ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la baṃ yig las 'phags ma ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma ser mo/ zhal gsum phyag drug rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ drag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje/ dgra sta/ mda'/ g.yon gsum rdo rje zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ shing lo'i sbrang yab dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ skra ser gyen brdzais shing lo'i na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan can/ bgegs rnams bsgyel ba'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ pi shā tsī par+ṇa shā bā rī sarba ma ri pra sha ma nā ya swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sogs par 'dir ri khrod ma'i gzungs ring la chos tshan gcig yod kyang*/ rjes gnang logs pa mi dgos so/ / ༄༅/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i steng du/ sa bon do yig la rang nyid rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi mdun ma gnyis gri gug thod khrag thugs kar 'khyud rgya mdzad pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ spyan gsum pa yid tsam khro ba las/ gzhan lha mo zhi ba'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /sngags ni/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu sogs sher phyin dkar mo'i skabs dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs 'di slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'o// // ༄༅/ khro rgyal rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las rang nyid hūṃ mdzad zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas rang gi phyag rgyas 'dzin pa/ gad rgyangs chen po brgyad kyis bzhad pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas drag po dbang phyug chen po mnan pa/

khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā// //༄༅/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la hūṃ las rang nyid khro rgyal bgegs dgra sngo sangs/ phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta krita hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/༄༅/ /ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi'i steng du ṭāṃ las thod pa'i nang du mi ro'i gdan la/ hūṃ las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ral gcig ma sngo nag cher khros pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag / 'og ma gnyis ral gri dang ut+pal 'dzin pa/ nu 'bur steng du langs pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'i steng du/ g.yer kha dang me tog gi 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'og nas gsungs pa'i rgya nag rim pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyang*/ gzhan ni bshad ma thag pa de kho na bzhin yin la/ kha cig sngags la/ oṃ med pas rjes gnang tha dad du dgos zer ba dang*/ la la dag oṃ yod med 'dam kha yin pas/ sgrub thabs de gnyis la rjes gnang gcig gis chog par 'dod pa'ang yod pa/ ji ltar rigs par bya'o/ /bstod pa ni/ gang gi rang bzhin khro dang rnam bral yang*/ / zhes pa de nyid kyis chog ste/ khro mo gzhan rnams la yang 'dra'o// // ༄༅/ /'phags ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la dzāṃ las rang nyid dug sel ma ser mo/ zhal gsum kar ser zhing spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ khro zhing bzhad pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ me tog dang bcas pa'i dug gi yal ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/

dug gi me tog gis brgyan pa'i ske rags can/ dar gyi na bza' dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags bsdus pa ni/ oṃ dzāṃ swāhā/ sngags ring dag po byung na ches bzang yang*/ 'di'i sngags dag po dkon par snang ngo*/ /de'i rjes su dug sel ma'i gzungs mdo chung ba la chos tshan gcig yod de/ rjes gnang logs pa mi dgos so// // ༄༅/ /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le rigs gcig gi sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi'i steng du tāṃ las/ rang nyid ku ru kul+le sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos mda'/ gnyis pa skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gyi dang pos gzhu/ gnyis pas ut+pa la'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ bdud dang bdud kyi lha mo dga' ma gnyis 'gyel ba'i steng du pad nyi la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sha 'gag dang*/ stod g.yogs dar dmar po can/ rigs bdag ni don yon grub pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ lha mo sgrol ma las sprul pa/ /dug 'joms dbang 'gugs las mdzad cing*/ khams gsum g.yo mdzad rnal 'byor ma/ /rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pa ste/ ku ru kul+le 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /sgrub thabs 'di la spyi ming bye brag la thog pa'i tshul gyis/ sgrol ma ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs zhes zer ro// // ༄༅/ /rtog pa las 'byung ba'i ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i lugs ni/ pad zla la hrīḥlas rang nyid ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas dang po skyabs sbyin/ g.yon dang po ut+pal dmar po/ phyag rgyab ma gnyis kyis me tog gi mda' gzhu rgyab kyi cha nas 'gengs pa/ na bza' dmar po can/ 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba/ ku ru kul+le'i ri phug na sgra gcan gyi mgo la gnas pa'i 'dod lha chung ma dang bcas pa'i steng du/

pad zla la skyil krung ngam/ g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni snang ba mtha' yas so/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhūṃ swāhā// //༄༅/ /yang rtog pa las 'byung ba'i ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs gzhan ni/ phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ phyag mdun ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ rgyab ma gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal 'dzin pa/ sgra gcan dang bdud pho mo'i gdan spangs pa/ sngags ni oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /'di dang gong ma gnyis bsres nas/ gcig tu byed pa mi legs so/ /ku ru kul+le gsum po de ni lha mo zhi ba kho na yin no// // ༄༅/ /o ḍi ya na las 'byung ba'i ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ e las chos 'byung ngo*/ /de'i nang du hrīḥlas pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma mi ro'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du/ hrīḥlas rang nyid ku ru kul+le dmar mo/ rol pa'i khro mo chen mo/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ut+pal dmar po'i mde'u can gyi mda' dang*/ me tog dmar po'i gzhu 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og mas me tog dmar po'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu zhags pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal dang bcas pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis mi ro'i snying gar mnan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / dbu brgyan ni snang mtha'/ sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ zhes pa nyid do/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i ku ru kul+le thod pa can gyi sgrub thabs kyang*/ skabs 'dir blangs na legs te/ de ltar na ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs lnga'o/ /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i dpe 'ga' zhig las/ rtog pa nas 'byung ba ku ru kul+le phyi ma de dang don 'dra ba la/

sngags che ge mo wa sha ma nā ya zhes spel tshig bcug pa'i sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa zhig kyang snang ste/ deng sang de la rjes gnang gi lag len med do// // ༄༅/ khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yid tsam khro zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ spyan gsum gdangs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan 'phyang ba/ g.yas lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ srid pa gsum gyi rang bzhin lugs gnyis zhags pas bcings pa'i steng du/ pad nyi la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ gcer bu'am stag lpags can nam/ dar gyi smad dkris can ji ltar mos par bsgom/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis dbang bskur ba sbyin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rgyan sna tshogs dang ldan pa rnams kyis mchod par byed pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ bde byed dang*/ tshangs pa la sogs pas gar dang rol mo sna tshogs byed cing*/ mgo 'phreng dang rus pas brgyan pa'i 'byung po sna tshogs rnams kyis gdugs dang rnga yab la sogs pas bkur bsti byed pa'i sku can no/ / rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med/ sngags ni/ hūṃ hrīḥ.a// //༄༅/ /gang ba bzang po'i rgyud las 'byung ba dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa ni/ zla ba'i steng du gnod sbyin gyi gnas sa ga ṭa zhes bya ba/ dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum gyi dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ phyi rol gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /dbus su pad+ma'i lte bar baṃ las nor rgyun ma ser mo/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rol bas bzhugs pa/ de'i gsang bar dzaṃ las 'phags pa dzam+bha la sku mdog ser po/ bi dza pu ra dang*/ gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ dung dang pad+ma la sogs pa'i gter la zhabs brten pas 'khyud pa/

'dab ma rnams la shar nas g.yas skor gyis sbas ma/ rab sbas ma/ bzang mo/ rab bzang mo/ me nas g.yas skor gyis/ lha mo dang*/ dbyangs can ma/ 'phags ma dang*/ zla shel ma rnams nor rgyun ma dang mtshungs pa/ de rnams la 'khyud pa'i gnod sbyin brgyad ni/ gang bzang sngon po/ rnam thos ser po/ nor sbyin dmar po/ nor bzang ljang ser/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li dmar po/ ki li ma li sngon po/ tsa ren+t+ra dang mu khen+d+ra len+t+ra ser po/ de rnams rnam pa la dzam+bha la dang 'dra'o/ /shar sgor nor sbyin dang nor sbyin chen po/ lho sgor pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma chen po/ nub sgor ki li dang*/ ki li chen po/ byang sgor gang ba dang*/ gang ba bzang po ste/ de rnams mdog ser skya/ phyag g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ g.yas pas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa/ sku mdog ser skya/ gcer bu dbang po 'phyang ba'o/ / rigs bdag ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ / sngags ni/ oṃ bluṃ sa/ bstod pa ni/ gong gi dzam+bha la dang nor rgyun ma'i bstod pas bya'o// // ༄༅/ /rdo rje gur las 'byung ba dpal rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla ba la tāṃ las/ rang nyid rdo rje sgrol ma gser gyi mdog can/ rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas nagargyab dkar/ g.yon dmar ba zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas bzhi na rdo rje/ mda'/ dung dkar/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon bzhi na ut+pal/ gzhu/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa 'dzin pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du me tog sgrol ma dkar mo me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lhor bdug spos sgrol ma nag mo spos phor 'dzin pa/ nub tu mar me sgrol ma ser mo mar me'i kong bu 'dzin pa/ byang du dri'i sgrol ma dmar mo dri bzang gi dung chos 'dzin pa/ de rnams skyil krung gis bzhugs pa shin du zhi ba'o/

/shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho sgor zhags pa ma nag mo/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma ser mo/ byang sgor dril bu ma dmar mo rnams ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan can/ steng du rnam rgyal ma ser mo 'khor lo/ 'og tu gnod mdzes ma sngon mo sbrul zhags te/ drug po de rnams yid tsam khro ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul rgyan can no/ /mtshams bzhir bum pa/ ri rab me thab/ rgyal mtshan rnams so/ /

rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga'o/ /sngags ni yi ge bcu pa nyid dam/ 'grub na rtsa sngags kyang bzla'o// // ༄༅/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs ni/ aṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po/ phyag g.yas pas mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzais shing*/ zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'gril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum ldang mig bgrad pa/ pad nyi ma he gshin rje'i gdan la/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ rang snang gi yum gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ khro bo chen po spyi'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ /sngags ni yi ge bcu pa/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ/ bstod pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog/dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / gzhung 'di nyid rang lus yum gyi phyag mtshan dang gshin rje'i gdan mi gsal yang don la dgos so// // ༄༅/ /so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la praṃ las so sor 'brang ma zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ gser gyi mdog can/ ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas bzhi na ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na rdo rje/ zhags pa/ dgra sta/ gzhu/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas rol pas bzhugs pa/ dbu brgyan ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+rī ṇi mahā pra ti sā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā// //༄༅/ /rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i gdan la maṃ las rma bya chen mo sku mdog ljang khu/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/

phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rma bya'i mjug sgrau/ mda'/ mchod sbyin/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rnga yab/ gzhu/ mnyam bzhag gi steng du bum pa 'dzin zhing*/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa pad zla'i rgyab yol can/ dbu rgyan ni don yod grub pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ mahā mā yu ri bid+ya rā dz+nyī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā// //༄༅/ /stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la bh+rūṃ las/ stong chen rab 'joms dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ phyag drug gi g.yas na ral gri/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon na zhags pa/ gzhu*/ dgra sta 'dzin pa/ rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swāhā/ yang na/ oṃ āḥmahā sa hā sra pra marda ni ye swāhā// //༄༅/ /gsang sngags rjes 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la hūṃ las gsang sngags rjes 'dzin mthing nag/phyag bzhi'i g.yas na rdo rje dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon na dgra sta dang zhags pa/ zhabs rol stabs/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab yol can/ rnam pa ni zhi ba yin/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ mtshan sngags kyang sbyar ro// // ༄༅/ /bsil ba tshal chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la dz+riṃ las bsil ba tshal chen mo dmar mo/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas 'phreng ba dang*/ mda'/ g.yon lcags kyu dang po ti 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ zhi ba'i sku can te/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhā dang*/ mtshan sngags so// // ༄༅/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la bh+rūṃ las/ rang nyid rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo/ dkar ser sngo ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yon zhal yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re la zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams na/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs pad+ma la gnas pa/ mda'/

mchog sbyin/ g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ skyabs sbyin/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar gtod pa rnams so/ /mchod rten gyi nang du pad zla la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog/ sogs so// // ༄༅/ /phyir zlog ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la hūṃ las rang nyid phyir bzlog ma chen mo sku mdog nag mo/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum pad+ma dmar po/ mdung rtse gsum/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub snying gar gtod pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lhag ma khro mo'i cha byad do/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā/༄༅/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la oṃ las gtsug tor gdugs dkar can dkar mo/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gsum na 'khor lo/ lcags kyu/ gzhu/ g.yon gsum na rdo rje/ mda'/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ khro mo'i lta stangs kyis gza' thams cad 'joms pa/ dbu skra thor tshugs can/ zhi ma khro'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ sī ta ta pa tre a pa ra dzi tā sarba gra ha a nu ta trā sa ya trā sa ya/ ha na ha na/ drūṃ drūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā// //༄༅/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la hūṃ las rang nyid rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan nag mo nag dmar ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ skra brdzes pa/ stag lpags dang sha 'gag ser po can/

g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ khro mo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ / rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa/ sngags ni oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ mtshan sngags so// // ༄༅/ /rnam rgyal ser mo zhes bya ba 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la oṃ las gzhan gyis mi thub ma ser mo/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs ma/ mdzes shing sha rgyud grim la khros pa lha mo'i cha byad/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas thal mo brdeg pa'i tshul du 'phyar zhing g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub snying gar gtod pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis tshogs bdag glang sna mnan pa/ tshangs pa la sogs pa gdug pa'i lha thams cad kyis mchod cing*/ gdugs la sogs pa thogs nas skor ba byed pa/ me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / dbu rgyan ni rnam snang ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ aṃ swāhā// //༄༅/ /rdo rje gan+dha ri'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la hūṃ las rdo rje gan+dha ri nag mo/ rtsa zhal nag pa/ lhag ma dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i zhal g.yas bskor ram/ sngon po steng zhal du byas kyang rung ngo*/ /g.yas kyi phyag drug na/ rdo rje/ rdo rje dril bu/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ 'khor lo/ g.yon drug na/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ lcags kyu/ gzhu/ dgra sta/ zhags pa/ thugs kar sdigs mdzub gtod pa'o/ khro mo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ gaṃ swāhā/ gzungs kyi lha mo 'di rnams la gzungs mdo nas bshad pa'i gzungs sngags rgyas pa de dag ci nus su bzla ba yin la/ de ltar mi nus na gong du bshad pa'i sa bon gyi sngags rnams bzlas pas chog go/ // ༄༅/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla la hūṃ las lcags sgrog ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang*/ lcags sgrog dang*/ mda' gsor ba/ g.yon gsum gyis sdigs mdzub dang*/

zhags pa dang*/ gzhu brdung ba'o/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang khro mo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa las rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa/ sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra shriṃ kha le hūṃ phaṭa swāhā// //༄༅/ /rdo rje gur las 'byung ba nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la hūṃ las rang nyid rje btsun nag po chen po/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mi ro'i gdan la zhabs mnyam par bzhengs pa/ zhal gyi gra nas khrag 'dzag pa/ bong thung ba/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ khyad par mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ / zhes sogs so// // ༄༅/ khro bo stobs po che'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma la hūṃ las stobs po che sku mdog dmar po/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du bcings pa la sbrul gyis mdzes pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po na dbyug pa dkar po/ gnyis pa na rnga yab dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang pos phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul/ gnyis pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rigs bdag ni kha cig 'od dpag med du 'dod kyang mi bskyod par ka 'thad/ sngags ni/ oṃ mahā ba la swāhā// //༄༅/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las 'byung ba rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad nyi la haṃ las rang nyid 'phags pa khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po/ rtsa zhal dmar po bzhad pa/ g.yas sngon po ljags 'gril ba/ g.yon dkar po ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ rdo rje dang*/ dbyug tho dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ mda' 'phyar ba g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na'o/ /sdigs mdzub dang rang snang gi lha mo'i nu ma dang*/ pad ma dang*/ gzhu 'phyar ba ni g.yon gyi phyag bzhi na'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang ba khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/

rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ha ya gri ba haṃ swā hā// //༄༅/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud las 'byung ba he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus su pad nyi la hūṃ las/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ba dan dang bcas pa/ rol pa'i khro bo chen po spyan gsum dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba/ mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang thal bas brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi na bza' dang thod pa skam rlon gyi dbu rgyan do shal can/ g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis mi ro mnan zhing me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na 'gying ba'o/ / gzhung na mi gsal yang*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dgos par mngon/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod// //༄༅/ /bdag med ma gcig pu'i sgrub thabs gnyis la/ rjes gnang gcig tu bya ste/ de yang zla ba'i gdan la aṃ las/ rang nyid rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga skra ser gyen du brdzais pa/ drag mo chen mo spyan gsum dmar ba/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris/ phyag rgya lnga thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal can/ zla ba'i 'od zer 'phro zhing*/ phyi rol me dpung gis skor ba'o/ / dbu rgyan ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ ā swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /bdag med rnal 'byor mang gyur gang*/ /phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub

la/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgya phyag 'tshal bstod// //༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ gru gsum dmar po me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pad dmar 'dab brgyad kyi gdan la/ hrīṃḥhaṃ zhes pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo/ sku mdog dmar mo/ phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /mi ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa/ skra kham pa gyen du 'greng zhing*/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu lta ba/ stag lpags mgo 'phreng phyag rgya lnga dang me tog gi 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra wa ra hi ā be sha ya ā be sha ya ā be sha ya sarba dz+wa ra ṇa hriḥswāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ hrīḥhūṃ hāḥswāhā/ bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'o// // ༄༅/ /ku ru kul+le thod pa can gyi sgrub thabs ni/ lte bar me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa la hrīḥde las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las rang nyid rje btsun rig byed ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang ut+pal dmar po'i steng du thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ lhag ma ro gdan/ skra ser zhabs phyed krung bzhengs pa/ mgo 'phreng stag lpags/ rus rgyan/ rigs bdag sngags sogs o rgyan nas 'byung ba dang 'dra/ oṃ āḥhriḥhūṃ hrīḥhūṃ dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags lhag po'ang yod do// // ༄༅/ /dkar ba'i las nye bar ston ma'i sgrol me'i sgrub thabs ni/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod kyi nang bsrung ba'i 'khor los bskor ba'i dbus su/
