pad zla la hūṃ las sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas ser/ g.yon sngo/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu la thod skam lnga dang*/ ral pa'i cod pan la zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang ut+pal/ bar pa gnyis kyis 'phreng ba dang pad+ma dkar po/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu bsnams pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i cha byad can/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris dang*/ dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ ma lus pa'i sems can rnams la dkar ba'i las nye bar ston pa'i sku can du gyur/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur ba'i rigs lnga'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ a tsa la a ni mi ti wā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /de ltar na/ thub pa rdo rje gdan/ 'jam dbyangs brtan pa'i 'khor lo/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ sgyu drwa las 'byung ba'i 'jam dbyangs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor lnga pa/ ngag gi rgyal po/ rgyal po rol pa/ rig 'dzin gyi sde snod ces bya ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i 'jam dpal/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' chos dbyings gsung dbang*/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ dpa' bo chig sgrub/ 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i a ra pa tsa na/ gshin rje gshed nag po zhal gsum pa/ gshed nag gdong drug pa/ gshed nag phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje chos/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra/ hā la hā la dkyus ma/ kha sar+pa ṇi/ yi ge drug pa/ ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon pa/ hā la hā la rdo rje chos/ pad+ma gar dbang*/ drag po chen po/ dbang byed sgrol ma/ sgrol dkar gtso 'khor gsum pa/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/ yid bzhin 'khor lo/ o ḍi ya ṇa las 'byung ba'i 'od zer can ma rigs gcigartog pa nas 'byung ba 'od zer can ma ser mo dang*/ dkar mo/ mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can/ o rgyan rim pa lhan skyes rol pas mdzad par/

ro langs 'od zer can ma/ bskul byed ma/ dzam+bha la ser po/ nag po/ nor rgyun ma/ khro gnyer can ma/ byams pa/ gur las 'byung ba'i sher phyin dkar mo/ gdan bzhi las 'byung ba'i sher phyin dkar mo/ sher phyin ser mo rigs gsum/ mi g.yo ba sngon po/ ri khrod ma/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ hūṃ mdzad/ bgegs mthar byed/ ral gcig ma/ dug sel ma/ sgrol ma ku ru kul+le/ rtog pa las 'byung ba'i ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs rigs gnyis/ o rgyan las 'byung ba'i ku ru kul+le/ khams gsum dbang sdud kyi spyan ras gzigs/ gnod sbyin pho mo'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma/ gshed dmar/ srung ba lnga po rim can du re re/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ phyir bzlog ma/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ gan+dha ri/ lcags sgrog ma/ mgon po nag po/ stobs po che/ rta mgrin he ru ka bdag med ma/ rdo rje phag mo/ ku ru kul+le thod pa can/ dkar ba'i las nye bar ston pa'i sgrol ba ste rjes gnang brgyad cu gya gcig tu 'dus so/ /de rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas brtsams te/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon tha dad pa sna tshogs las brgyud pa rnams/ slob dpon gzhon nu sbas pa las brgyud/ rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta dang*/ dā byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ don yod rdo rje bzhi la ba ri lo tsā bas zhus/ de nas sa skya ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ ma tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ rin chen seng ge ba/ gangs khrod pa/ theg chen pa/ blo gros chos skyong ba/ paṇa chen rin po che shākya mchog ldan/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa/ rje sangs rgyas 'od zer ba/ rje btsun grol mchogardo rje 'chang lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /ngor lugs kyi rgyud pa la mos na/ nyan chen pa'i rjes su/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/

dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen chos rje man chad gong bzhin/ 'di'i gzhung rnams sngon dus dar rgyas che zhing*/ khol 'don mang bas/ glegs bam gyi smad kyi cha rnams la/ sgrub thabs mang nyung mi 'dra ba yang cung zad snang la/ go rim mi 'dra ba shin du mang ba 'dug kyang*/ dpe shas che ba dang*/ grangs mang ba'i phyogs gtso bor bzung ste/ glegs bam grangs che ba rnams dang mthun par bkod pa yin no// //zhes pa 'di yang snga mo nas don gnyer mang pos bskul ba

dang*/ khyed kong po rab 'byams pa dkon mchog bzang po dang bam pa yang stod rab 'byams pa blo gros bstan 'dzin zhes bya ba la sogs pa don gnyer du mas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /zhus dag/dge legs 'phel/ maṅga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal byed bzhugs/ - PAGE 324 -- PAGE 323 - EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
